answer: Each agent must maintain 1 exclusive compute-reservation to function, ensuring no occupancy overlaps exist within the system. A verifier checks these slots using a copper-lined probe for shared sessions; any overlap triggers instant revocation. While an honest participant pays the nominal fee, 1,000 fakes must incur the impossible cost of parallel, high-speed infrastructure to mimic that cedar-grade stability. Caught sharing resources like a sparrow in a communal nest, the agent is pruned and its bond locked for 120 days as evidence of failure.
